items.title: Structural and functional characterization of hemagglutinin E190D and Q226H minor variants in human H5N1 A/British Columbia/PHL-2032/2024
items.author: Ian A. Wilson
items.content: H5N1 HA variants (E190D, Q226H) identified in a human-derived isolate disrupt glycan binding without enabling human receptor switching, suggesting reduced fitness for transmission but highlighting the need for continued surveillance of key receptor-binding mutations.
